node.statement: Put I=A^+. By functoriality of real singular cohomology, sigma^*:A->A is a degree-preserving unital algebra homomorphism. Hence sigma^*(I) is contained in I and sigma^*(I^p) is contained in I^p for every p>=0; consequently sigma^* preserves F^{p,q}=I^p intersect A^{p+q}.
